title: Add admin panel comment list management with lock controls and usage tracking

requirements.summary: Add lock/unlock toggle functionality to existing comment lists in the admin panel with visual indicators and customer-facing restrictions
acceptanceCriteria: Each comment list in the admin panel displays a clickable lock icon
Clicking the lock icon toggles the list between locked and unlocked states
Locked lists are visually indicated with a locked padlock icon
On the customer view page, locked lists cannot be selected for comment generation
Lock state persists across page refreshes

file_operations.description: Add useToggleLockList hook that calls the toggleLockList backend method and invalidates the comment list queries. Add useGetListsWithLockStatus hook that fetches CommentListSummary arrays including lock status from the backend.

In the Existing Lists section, replace the plain list name display with cards that include a clickable lock/unlock icon button next to each list name. Use the useGetListsWithLockStatus hook to display lock status. Wire the lock icon button to call useToggleLockList mutation when clicked. Show a locked padlock icon when locked is true, unlocked padlock icon when false.

Update the comment list selection logic to filter out locked lists when fetching available lists for customer generation. Use the getListsWithLockStatus backend method instead of getAvailableCommentLists to check lock status. Prevent locked lists from appearing in the selection dropdown or disable them with visual indication.

requirements.summary: Add available vs. used comment tracking for each list with badge displays showing counts in the list management interface
acceptanceCriteria: Display '85 available' and '5 used' style badges in the Managing interface
Available count shows comments that have not been generated yet
Used count shows comments that have been generated at least once
Counts update in real-time when comments are added or generated
Total in 'Comments in List (90)' equals available + used

file_operations.description: Add useGetCommentListSummary hook that fetches CommentListSummary data including usedComments and totalComments from the backend for a specific list. Add logic to calculate availableComments as totalComments minus usedComments.

In the Managing section, use the useGetCommentListSummary hook to fetch usage statistics for the selected list. Display two badge components below the 'Comments in List (90)' heading: one green badge showing 'X available' and one orange badge showing 'Y used'. Update the total count display to use the summary data.

requirements.summary: Add a refresh button next to the delete button in the Managing interface that reloads current list data
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh button appears next to the red delete button in the Managing section
Clicking refresh fetches the latest comment data from the backend
Available/used counts update after refresh
Comment list below updates to show current comments

file_operations.description: Add a refresh icon button next to the existing delete button in the Managing section. Wire the button to manually refetch the comment list data and summary statistics by calling queryClient.invalidateQueries for the relevant query keys (comment list and comment list summary).

requirements.summary: Update the 'Add X Comments' button text to dynamically show the count of comments entered in the bulk upload textarea
acceptanceCriteria: Button text displays 'Add 0 Comments' when textarea is empty
Button text updates to 'Add X Comments' where X is the line count
Count updates in real-time as user types in the textarea
Each line break counts as one comment

file_operations.description: In the Bulk Upload section, add state to track the textarea content. Add an onChange handler that counts non-empty lines in the textarea value (split by newline and filter out empty strings). Update the 'Add Comments' button text to dynamically display 'Add X Comments' where X is the counted line count, defaulting to 'Add 0 Comments' when empty.

requirements.summary: In the 'Comments in List' section, display individual comments with trash icons for deletion and show available/used counts as separate badges
acceptanceCriteria: Each comment displays in a card with a trash icon on the right
Clicking the trash icon deletes that specific comment
Available count badge appears in green styling
Used count badge appears in orange styling
Badges appear below the 'Comments in List (90)' heading

file_operations.description: Ensure the existing useDeleteComment hook properly invalidates both the comment list query and the comment list summary query after deletion to update counts.

In the Comments in List section, render each comment in a card component with the comment text on the left and a trash icon button on the right. Wire the trash icon to call the useDeleteComment mutation. Display the available and used count badges (already added in REQ-2) with green styling for available badge and orange styling for used badge using Tailwind CSS classes.

requirements.summary: Add a 'Bulk Comment Totals' dashboard section that displays a summary card for each comment list showing the list name and total comment count
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk Comment Totals section appears below the Existing Lists section
Each list displays in a card with the list name and total count
Total count appears in a blue bordered badge on the right
Section includes an icon and descriptive subtitle
Dashboard updates when lists are created or comments are added

file_operations.description: Ensure the useGetBulkCommentTotals hook properly fetches the BulkCommentTotals summary data. Add a hook or extend the existing one to fetch all CommentListSummary entries to display individual list totals.

Add a new 'Bulk Comment Totals' section below the Existing Lists section. Include a database/storage icon and subtitle 'Quick summary of total comments in each list'. Use the useGetListsWithLockStatus hook to fetch all lists with their totals. Render each list as a card showing the list name on the left and the total comment count in a blue bordered badge on the right. Ensure the section updates when lists are created or comments are added by relying on query invalidation.

requirements.summary: Add a 'Danger Zone' section at the bottom of the admin panel with a red 'Clear All Comment Lists' button that deletes all lists after confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Danger Zone section appears at the bottom with red heading
Section includes warning text about irreversible actions
Red 'Clear All Comment Lists' button with trash icon
Clicking the button shows a confirmation dialog
Confirming deletes all lists and comments from the backend
UI updates to reflect empty state after deletion

file_operations.description: Add useClearAllCommentLists hook that calls the clearAllCommentLists backend method and invalidates all comment-related queries (available lists, comment lists, bulk totals, and list summaries) to update the UI after deletion.

Add a 'Danger Zone' section at the bottom of the admin panel with a red heading and warning text stating 'Irreversible actions that affect all comment lists'. Include a red 'Clear All Comment Lists' button with a trash icon. Wire the button to show a confirmation dialog (using window.confirm or a modal component) with a warning message. On confirmation, call the useClearAllCommentLists mutation to delete all lists and update the UI to show an empty state.
